caption: The drawing shows a piece of furniture in the center that appears to be a wooden writing desk or bureau, colored in shades of brown with darker lines indicating edges and drawer separations. The desk has a slanted top compartment and two larger rectangular drawers beneath it, with four small round feet visible at the bottom. Above the central colored drawing, there is a pencil sketch of the interior of the desk, which displays an arrangement of drawers and small compartments. In the lower left corner, two additional pencil sketches present sectional views of the desk: one is labeled "SIDE VIEW" and shows the proportions and structure from the side, while the other sketch beside it illustrates the desk from a lower angle, possibly showing the base or legs. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color, and the artist’s signature, “Edwin Rice,” is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Desk
